# GoPro GPMF fixture

`hero6-gps-payload.bin` is the first GPMF payload (one sample of the `gpmd`
metadata track, 17 GPS fixes) of `samples/hero6.mp4` from GoPro's
[gpmf-parser](https://github.com/gopro/gpmf-parser) repository, used to test
`src/video/gopro-gps.js` against real camera output. It is redistributed under
that repository's licence, included here as `LICENSE.txt`.
